title: Add prompt segment hashing to observability trace emission
description:
Add prompt segment hashing to the observability trace emission in `chatbot/observability/traces.py`.

Modify `chatbot/observability/traces.py` to hash prompt segments and record these hashes in the observability traces. This ensures we can trace prompt telemetry and trace composition patterns without logging sensitive user/companion prompt text directly.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/observability/traces.py to see how traces are emitted and structured

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/observability/traces.py exists and is a valid Python module
Trace emissions include hashed segments for prompt components
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: use standard python hashlib (e.g. md5 or sha256) for hashing prompt segments
add hash fields to trace objects/payloads
forbidden: log raw/unhashed prompt text to the trace stream
change external API interfaces for telemetry dashboards
